title: actor.register — Request
description: Register a new human actor and mint a credential. v0.1.2 restricts `kind` to `human` only — agent registration is intentionally deferred until a capabilities/spawn model is defined. Idempotent via operation_id (same operation_id replays the original response shape; see actor.register.res.json for the redaction rule). The plaintext token is returned exactly once on first call.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7 (time-ordered). Same operation_id replays the cached response (with the token field redacted). Same operation_id with a different request body returns 409 Conflict.

kind.description: v0.1.2 only allows `human`. Agent registration (with parent_actor_id and runtime metadata) is deferred until a capabilities model lands.
